title: K-Electric Linked to Rs. 34 Billion Circular Debt Rise
excerpt: The Power Division attributes a Rs. 34 billion increase in Pakistan's power-sector circular debt to unpaid K-Electric bills.
body_html:
The Power Division has stated that unpaid electricity bills involving K-Electric are responsible for a Rs. 34 billion rise in Pakistan's power-sector circular debt.

According to the Power Division, the accumulation of these unpaid bills has directly contributed to the worsening financial state of the country's power sector.
